_comment: world_objects.json - readable / searchable objects placed by Scripts/crafting_world_spawner.gd as WorldNote nodes (Scripts/world_note.gd), per zone. Fields are WorldNote's: title, note_text, label_text, start_quest, give_item, night_only, day_text, found_text, show_paper, show_stone, show_mirror, opens ('mirror': the appearance window). 'position' is [x, z]; the height comes from the ground. Hand-edited; positions are first guesses - check them in play (/location).

lumora_outskirts.title: Old Foundation Stone
lumora_outskirts.note_text: You lever up the old foundation stone. Beneath it, wrapped in oilcloth, lie a sealed letter and a small book.
lumora_outskirts.day_text: A heavy, worn foundation stone among the ruins. It doesn't budge, and in daylight you'd be seen trying. The note said nightfall.
lumora_outskirts.found_text: The hollow under the foundation stone is empty now.

lumora_outskirts.title: The Silvered Mirror
lumora_outskirts.note_text: A tall mirror in a dark wooden frame, its silver clear as still water.
